keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Jaakko Oksanen (Kairat).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Gustavo Mendonça (Kairat) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Relja Obric (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Aleksandr Mrynskiy (Kairat).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Atalanta 0, Kairat 0.
Substitution, Atalanta. Éderson replaces Kamaldeen Sulemana.
Goal! Atalanta 0, Kairat 1. Marc Gual (Kairat) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Edmilson following a fast break.
Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atalanta. Charles De Ketelaere replaces Lazar Samardzic.
Substitution, Atalanta. Nicola Zalewski replaces Jonathan Rowe.
Substitution, Kairat. Oiva Jukkola replaces Azamat Tuyakbayev.
Substitution, Kairat. Ismail Bekbolat replaces Edmilson.
Substitution, Atalanta. Nikola Krstovic replaces Gianluca Scamacca.
Substitution, Kairat. Erkin Tapalov replaces Marc Gual.
Substitution, Atalanta. Davide Zappacosta replaces Lorenzo Bernasconi.
Goal! Atalanta 1, Kairat 1. Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Relja Obric with a headed pass following a corner.
Substitution, Kairat. Adilet Sadybekov replaces Gustavo Mendonça.
Substitution, Kairat. Olzhas Baybek replaces Damir Kasabulat.
Delay in match because of an injury Aleksandr Shirobokov (Kairat).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Aleksandr Mrynskiy (Kairat) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ismail Bekbolat (Kairat) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Oiva Jukkola (Kairat) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Atalanta 1, Kairat 1.
